model_description: Compliant DLP-grokking model operating on raw (a, b, p): a trained StreamingDigitReducer (recurrent cell fed the raw operand digits one at a time on a fixed, feedback-free schedule) performs the learned modular reduction, then a shared Transformer residue-encoder maps the residues to vectors combined by ADDITION (a log-space / discrete-log inductive bias), and a decoder emits the answer digits. No hand-coded reduction, discrete-log table, or hand-coded modular arithmetic; both the reduction and the field multiplication are learned. Targets small primes (tiers 1-3); falls back to 0 for p >= 10^5.
training_description: Two-stage: (1) DLP core trained from scratch on synthetic residue-space examples sampled across many small primes (random primes spanning the tier 1-3 bit ranges) with held-out val primes, cross-entropy on fixed-width MSB-first answer digits, Adam on Apple MPS; (2) StreamingDigitReducer trained on raw-digit streams with per-prefix residue supervision (r' = (10r + d) mod p trajectories) over the same prime buckets, then merged into the checkpoint. At inference the model receives raw (a, b, p); no deterministic pre-reduction.
